questions.cardText:
[Economics] What is one effect of a central bank increasing interest rates on the exchange rate?
A. Appreciation of the domestic currency
B. Depreciation of the domestic currency
C. Decreasing the volatility of the exchange rate
Answer: A. Higher interest rates offer better returns on investments denominated in that currency, attracting foreign investors. This increased demand for the domestic currency drives up its value relative to other currencies. Additionally, higher interest rates can help control inflation, further strengthening the currency.
questions.de: Was geschieht typischerweise mit dem Wert der Landeswährung gegenüber anderen Währungen, wenn die Zentralbank die Zinsen erhöht und so ausländisches Kapital anzieht?
questions.en: What typically happens to the value of a country's currency against other currencies when its central bank raises interest rates and attracts foreign capital?

timeline.labelEn: Nixon ends the dollar's gold convertibility, leading to market-driven floating exchange rates
timeline.labelDe: Nixon beendet die Goldkonvertibilität des Dollars – der Weg zu frei schwankenden Wechselkursen

questions.notes: A tendency, not a law: uncovered interest rate parity predicts the opposite in theory, though in practice high-interest currencies usually appreciate. Answer accepted as "appreciation / it strengthens".

questions.cardText:
[Philosophy] What does epistemology study?
A. Ethics B. Beauty C. Knowledge
Answer: C.
questions.de: Womit befasst sich die Epistemologie, der auch Erkenntnistheorie genannte Zweig der Philosophie?
questions.en: What does epistemology, the branch of philosophy also called the theory of knowledge, study?

timeline.labelEn: James Frederick Ferrier first uses "epistemology" as the name of a branch of philosophy
timeline.labelDe: James Frederick Ferrier verwendet „Epistemologie“ erstmals als Name eines Zweigs der Philosophie

questions.notes: Answer covers the nature, origin and limits of knowledge (and justified belief).
